# Discovered and Fixed Web Constraint

The first plugin create request was explicitly rejected by `/creator/wow/mod/create` with business code `-4` because the webpage requires at least one screenshot. The input was then corrected with an existing media reference, the schema was tightened to require `screenshots` or `screenshot_files`, and the same private create completed successfully.

# Commands and results

All commands and literal exit statuses are recorded above and in the redacted JSON receipt. The complete test suite, compile check, diff check, CLI/reference audit, read-only dependency probes, and live private CRUD matrix all exited successfully.

# Skipped checks

Exploration Season was intentionally excluded from live mutation per the change contract. No other acceptance check was skipped.

# Spec consistency

The implementation, CLI schemas/help, Skill, NewBee reference, README, and tracked publish record cover the three resource families and the webpage-aligned dependency, mutation, readback, error, and cleanup behavior in the active specs.

# Known limitations and risks

The live verification used private temporary records and the currently authenticated Creator Center session. The remote service may add fields or change validation rules; future writes must continue to perform dynamic GET and readback before mutation or retry.

# Conclusion

PASS. The requested Python NewBeeBox web-behavior alignment is implemented and verified, with exact-ID cleanup completed.
